gaugeContext.note: No representative gauge has been reviewed for these trips. A nearby Waupaca River reading is not substituted for Crystal River flow. Published county guide times remain available.

timing.note: No reviewed speed/flow calibration or representative gauge is assigned. County-published trip times are planning guidance only.

blurb: Two county-published paddling trips near Waupaca: Rural to Nelson Park, then Nelson Park to the public landing on Shadow Lake. Includes moving water, wooded bends and a lake exit.

sections.difficulty: Class II rapids marked in county guide
sections.notes: A winding paddle through Junction Lake with bridges and rapids. The county map marks Class II rapids near County K. Start below Rural Dam and finish at the public Nelson Park access. Arrange a vehicle shuttle between the two accesses.

sections.routeReview: The dotted river path is still under review near the former Little Hope impoundment. Use the access markers and published county guide for planning.

notices.title: Launch below Rural Dam
notices.text: The launch area is beside an existing dam. Use the downstream access described in the county guide; no dam crossing or portage is included in this trip.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR dam inventory; Waupaca County paddling map

putInAccess.operator: Public access — managing agency not specified in county guide
putInAccess.sourceName: Waupaca County — public facilities and Crystal River paddling guide
putInAccess.note: The county guide and facility 19759 identify the public Rural launch. Its unchanged coordinate is on the downstream side of the Rural dam/bridge, with the bank approach partly obscured by trees. Keep an approximate area marker; this is not a surveyed landing or permission to cross the dam.
putInAccess.directions: Use the county-guide launch at Main Street and Cleghorn Road in Rural, downstream of Rural Dam. Confirm the below-dam launch and designated roadside parking before unloading; do not launch above the dam for this trip.

takeOutAccess.operator: Public access — managing agency not specified in county guide
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Waupaca County — public facilities and Crystal River paddling guide
takeOutAccess.note: County facility 36, the paddling guide and Town of Dayton park page identify Nelson Park on the Crystal River. The county coordinate falls in the island/footbridge area and does not identify a precise landing. Use the public park area, not the neighboring private mill grounds.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Nelson Park beside County Highway K near the Red Mill. Check the public riverbank landing in the park before launching or arranging the takeout; the marker identifies the park access area.

sections.difficulty: Moving water and lake paddling (county guide)
sections.notes: This trip finishes inside Shadow Lake. After Highway 10, follow the county guide’s signed connection into the lake and paddle to its west-shore public ramp. The lake connection runs against the outlet flow; the main river continues toward Felt Mill Dam. Arrange a shuttle and check the exit before launching.

notices.title: Turn into Shadow Lake for the takeout
notices.text: Look for the Shadow Lake turn after Highway 10. Do not continue down the main Crystal River toward Felt Mill Dam; this listing ends at the lake’s public ramp.

takeOutAccess.note: County facility 9391 agrees with the visible public concrete boat ramp on the west side of Shadow Lake. The unchanged county coordinate is retained as a desktop-reviewed landing; it is not a field GPS survey.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the public boat ramp on the west shore of Shadow Lake beside the park parking area. This takeout is inside the lake, reached by leaving the Crystal River through the signed lake connection; it is not on the downstream main river.
